# Backyard Pool Tips

> Independent pool equipment reviews and maintenance advice for backyard pool owners, written by Tom and Shirley Springsteen from 30 years running a pool shop. Buying guides start with the pool, not the product; recommendations are based on running cost and practical suitability, not commission.

## Buying guides

- [Best Pool Pump for Above-Ground Pools](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-pump-above-ground): Flow rate versus pool size, sizing, running costs, noise, and five pumps worth considering.
- [Best Pool Pump for Inground Pools](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-pump-inground): Single-speed vs variable-speed payback math, plumbing sizing, rebates, and five pumps worth considering.
- [Salt vs Chlorine: True Maintenance Cost](https://backyardpooltips.com/salt-vs-chlorine-cost): The real 3-year cost comparison between a salt chlorination system and manual chlorine dosing, plus five salt systems worth considering.
- [Best Pool Covers by Type & Size](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-covers): Solar, thermal, safety and winter covers explained and matched to climate and pool shape, plus five covers worth considering.
- [Best Pool Cleaning Robots & Equipment](https://backyardpooltips.com/best-pool-cleaning-robots): What separates a robot that climbs walls from one that gets stuck, runtime and filter maintenance, plus five cleaners worth considering.

## Maintenance guides

- [Cloudy Water? Start Here.](https://backyardpooltips.com/cloudy-water): A complete, step-by-step guide to fixing cloudy pool water — testing, balancing, and filtering in the right order, every likely cause explained, and the mistake that makes it worse.
- [Green Pool? How to Fix It](https://backyardpooltips.com/green-pool): Why pools turn green, the correct step-by-step order to clear an algae bloom, and how to stop it coming back.
- [How to Detect and Fix a Pool Leak](https://backyardpooltips.com/pool-leak): The bucket test to confirm a real leak vs normal evaporation, common leak locations, and when to call a professional.
- [Opening a Pool the Right Way](https://backyardpooltips.com/opening-a-pool): The correct order of operations for opening a pool for the season — cover off, prime the pump, balance before you shock.
- [Closing a Pool for Winter](https://backyardpooltips.com/closing-a-pool): What to drain, what to leave alone, and the step most guides skip when winterizing.
- [Common Pump & Filter Problems](https://backyardpooltips.com/pump-filter-problems): Symptom-to-fix troubleshooting for losing prime, short cycling, rising pressure, weak flow, and cloudy water.
